svg.title: Graph of g
svg.desc: Coordinate graph of g from −4 to 6, with two line segments, isolated filled points, two curved branches and a dashed vertical line at x = 4. A segment runs from filled (−4, 0) to open (−1, 3), with an isolated filled point at (−1, 1). Another segment runs from open (−1, −2) to open (2, 4); (2, 0) is filled. On 2 < x < 4 a continuous increasing curve starts near (2, 4) and continues upward beside x = 4. On 4 < x ≤ 6 a continuous decreasing curve continues upward beside x = 4 and ends at filled (6, 1). There is no point at x = 4.
